feature.en: DR Configuration and Drill now provide consistent namespace-scoped and cluster-scoped resource selection.
feature.zh-CN: DR Configuration 与 Drill 现在提供一致的命名空间级和集群级资源选择。

improvement.en: Custom resource catalogs are prefetched and cached per namespace, while configuration dialogs open immediately.
improvement.zh-CN: 自定义资源清单现在按命名空间预取并缓存，同时配置弹窗可以立即打开。

improvement.en: Velero and Comm Agent component upgrades now use published component releases and report progress in Recent Tasks.
improvement.zh-CN: Velero 与 Comm Agent 组件升级现在使用已发布的组件版本，并在 Recent Tasks 中报告进度。
